toe_representation_question_answered.question: does ONIQ have a separate toe/end-site representation, and how would a source toe joint be handled?
toe_representation_question_answered.answer: ONIQ carries REAL toe JOINTS — RightToeBase and LeftToeBase — in the Lower Limbs sagittal projection group. They are named joints in the canonical skeleton, not BVH End Site markers.
toe_representation_question_answered.consequence: a source RightToe/LeftToe would map onto RightToeBase/LeftToeBase rather than being dropped or synthesised. This is stated as the TARGET-side fact only.
